title: 🌍 Serrani around the world
intro: Did you leave Serracapriola? Type where you live (city or town, no street address), add your name if you like and press OK: a red pin will appear on the map. Zoom in and tap the pin to see the names.
notFound: Place not found, try writing it differently
added: Thanks! You are on the map
privacy1: Taking part in “Serrani in the World” is free and voluntary.
privacy2: Each user decides independently which data to share and personally chooses the place shown on the map. The location is not detected or published automatically.
privacy3: The data and location chosen by the user will be used exclusively for taking part in the map and may be visible to other visitors of the site.
dedica: For you... who left many years ago,
who left Serracapriola with a suitcase, a few dreams and perhaps a tear hidden in your eyes;
you in whom Serracapriola still lives in childhood memories, in the voices of loved ones, in streets walked a thousand times and in that wish that sooner or later returns: to see it again.
This map is for you, to remind you that wherever life has taken you, a part of your heart has stayed here.
Because even far away, you cannot stop being Serrani.
